decision.reason: [ev-de978b4c1ed8] is only a procedural step from the upgrade guide. It tells operators to review their cluster for "removed features" and points to a separate removed-features section, but it never names a specific removed feature. It does not say what changed, which environments are exposed or what happens if an operator does nothing. The removed-features sections themselves (each removed feature, with its inspection commands and migration tools) would be needed, and probably as separate changes, since this statement covers several removals at once.
